elsewhere.note: He cried and said, ‘Father Abraham, have mercy on me, and send Lazarus, that he may dip the tip of his finger in water, and cool my tongue! For I am in anguish…
“When forty years were fulfilled, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in the wilderness of Mount Sinai, in a flame of fire in a bush.
Of the angels he says, “He makes his angels winds, and his servants a flame of fire.”
His head and his hair were white as white wool, like snow. His eyes were like a flame of fire.
